ui_bugs.issue: When PUT /turmas/{id}/dominios returns 400 (e.g. removing a dominio still referenced by an instrumento), the UI shows generic 'Request failed with status code 400' instead of the backend's informative detail 'Não é possível remover domínios ainda usados em instrumentos (…). Edite ou elimine esses instrumentos primeiro.' Root cause: Config.js catch block uses e.message only; must use e?.response?.data?.detail like Instrumentos.js does (line 66). The problem statement explicitly requires that error to be shown.

issues: Copy still mentions 'ponderações' but that concept was replaced by editable 'domínios'. Update to: 'Cada turma tem os seus próprios alunos, instrumentos de avaliação e domínios.'

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/sections/Config.js, change catch block from setError(e.message || ...) to setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || e?.message || 'Erro ao guardar.') OR update Teacher.js saveDominios to re-throw with a friendlier Error. This is required so the 'Não é possível remover…' backend message reaches the user (explicitly listed in the problem statement acceptance criteria).
Update /app/frontend/src/components/TurmasEmpty.js copy: 'ponderações' → 'domínios' since ponderacoes endpoint was removed.
(Nice-to-have) Add Pydantic extra=forbid on TurmaCreate to reject stray 'nome' field with 422 instead of silently dropping it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_turma_or_404 mutates the returned dict to inject default DOMINIOS if missing but doesn't persist — acceptable read-time fallback for legacy turmas.
PUT /instrumentos/{id} nota-trimming logic (lines 373-379) is O(alunos*questoes) but correct; keeps only q ids present in new list — good behavior.
Config.js: peso is stored/edited as int via range slider; parseInt on save. If someone hand-crafts a payload with float peso the server will reject via Pydantic int coercion — fine.
Frontend: no debounce cap on Lançar notas debouncedSave — a rapid stream of edits will keep resetting the 600ms timer; user must pause. Acceptable UX pattern.
server.py still uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — technically invalid CORS spec (browsers reject cookies) but the app uses Bearer tokens, so it works. Flagged prior iterations.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; 1 UX error-message regression on remove-referenced-dominio)

PUT /turmas/{id}/dominios enforces sum=100, unique non-empty codes, and blocks removal of codes still referenced by any instrumento questão. Only real issue: Config.js swallows axios 400 detail — fix to surface e.response.data.detail so the required 'Não é possível remover…' message is visible.
rca of the issue: Frontend Config.js catch block uses `e.message` which for axios errors is 'Request failed with status code 400'. The backend's informative Portuguese message lives on `e.response.data.detail`. Fix (one-line): setError(e?.response?.data?.detail || e?.message || 'Erro ao guardar.'). Reproduction: create turma → Config → add ORG → create instrumento using ORG → return to Config → click X on ORG row → rebalance to 100 → click Guardar domínios → observe generic error instead of the 'Não é possível remover…' backend detail.
